label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Share a Quick, Useful Tip
body: Offer bite-sized advice or a helpful trick related to your niche in each email to build trust and show expertise.
caption:
Your audience appreciates learning. A simple, actionable tip can make your emails valuable, even when you're not selling. It keeps them engaged and reminds them you're a go-to resource in your field. Think about what small piece of knowledge could make their day a little easier or brighter. What's one thing you know that could genuinely help them right now?
